sentences.text:
Mr. Priyabrata Tripathy,
 Addl. Standing Counsel

Mr. G. K. Parida, Advocate for
 the informant
 Coram:
 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Video Conferencing/Physical Mode).

Mr.
G.K. Parida, learned counsel enters appearance for the informant by filing his Vakalatnama, which is taken on record.

This is an appeal under section 101 (5) of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act, 2015 in connection with Special G.R. Case No.132 of 2022 arising out of Talsara P.S. Case No.135 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum -P.O., Spl. Court under POCSO Act,
Sundargarh for offences // 2 // punishable under sections 376/363/376(D)/109/292 of the Indian Penal Code read with section 3(2)(v)(va) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act and section 67 of Information Technology Act.
The appellant moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum -P.O., Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Sundargarh, which was rejected on 28.11.2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is a case of gang rape and the petitioner has not only been named in the F.I.R. but also the victim who is a minor girl aged about sixteen years has implicated the petitioner in her 164 Cr.P.C.
statement in the commission of rape on her.
In view of the nature and gravity of accusation, I am not inclined to release the appellant on bail.
The prayer for bail stands rejected.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after examination of the victim in the learned trial Court.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Sipun Chaitanya Apat vs State Of Odisha & Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55759937/
